questions.q: What should leaders do to make a four-day week work?
a: Explain the purpose and involve staff in decisions
Announce the plan and let managers handle details
Keep the reasons private until it succeeds
Offer bonuses to anyone who objects
questions.why: Lesson 2 lists transparency, staff involvement, flexibility and shared decisions.

a: Raising productivity, not just granting a day off
Cutting the company’s salary costs

Reducing the number of office desks
